# EPAM Campus

> > Free industry-focused IT training and courses from EPAM, covering 30+ technology directions including Java, Python, .NET, DevOps, Data Engineering, and QA.

EPAM Campus provides beginner-friendly online IT education taught by industry experts from EPAM. The platform offers comprehensive training programs, self-study resources, and career guidance across software development, data practices, testing, and business analysis.

## Key Topics

- EPAM Campus training programs
- Java development
- Python programming
- .NET and C# development
- DevOps and automation
- Data Engineering and Analytics
- Quality Assurance and Testing
- Business Analysis
- Android and Kotlin
- Career development in IT
- Self-study resources
- Beginner IT courses
- Test automation
- Online learning platforms
- Skill development
